sealed_story_packet.headline: Gemini Skills turn repeated instructions into reusable team procedures
verified_visual_facts: Repeated task instructions are captured as a reusable Gemini Skill.
The Skill contains maintained instructions and examples for a bounded recurring task.
A named owner updates the Skill when the underlying process changes.
The maintained Skill is reused across similar team tasks.
generic_conceptual_elements: ad-hoc instruction fragments converging into one maintained module
sealed_story_packet.visual_brief: A reusable operating-knowledge pipeline: several recurring task prompts converge into one maintained Gemini Skill containing instructions and examples, pass through a named-owner checkpoint, then fan out to consistent team reuse with a process-update loop returning to the Skill.
